name: The Best Christmas Ever
label: TAM presents a festival of live music
lede: Live music, scene takeovers and the young artists of TAM Open Music Academy, all under the stained-glass glow of our Shard Christmas tree at Mercato Metropolitano.
datesNote: Twenty-one nights, opening on Friday 4 December. We close from Christmas Eve to the 28th, then come back on Tuesday 29 December for One More Christmas.

song.title: The Best Christmas Ever
song.about: The festival takes its name from Dana Gillespie's song, written for nights exactly like these. Dana is TAM's Mentor in Residence, and the song sets the tone for the whole season: loud, warm and built for a room full of people.

programme.title: Live Music
programme.text: Bands and artists on TAM's stage across the whole run, from first chord to last orders.

programme.title: Takeovers
programme.text: London collectives and scenes take over the room and curate the night their way.

programme.title: Young Artists
programme.text: Rising voices from TAM Open Music Academy, on the same stage as the headliners.

programme.title: Festive Nights
programme.text: Nights made for gathering your friends, your family and your whole crew.

donation.label: Donate to Guy’s & St Thomas’ Charity
donation.blurb: Every penny goes to Guy’s & St Thomas’ Charity, who supported Tam through his battle with brain cancer.
donation.intro: Guy’s & St Thomas’ Charity supported Tam through his battle with brain cancer. This Christmas we want to give something back. Add a donation when you book your tickets, or give to the charity directly.

raffle.draw: Drawn on the night, before the end of the show

sponsorship.intro: Bring the whole company, put your name on the festival and send every guest home with a TAM Christmas Box.
sponsorship.gift: The TAM Christmas Box comes with every sponsorship package, one for each of your guests.

cards.heading: Make it your Christmas card
cards.blurb: Add effects and Dana's Polaroids (or your own photos) over the song, write a message, and send your own version of The Best Christmas Ever.

claims.note: Everything at TAM in December is part of The Best Christmas Ever.
